desc: Enable panel backlight control, which a daily driver needs and which is currently absent. MEASURED: the full kernel has CONFIG_BACKLIGHT_CLASS_DEVICE=y but CONFIG_APPLE_DWI_BL is ABSENT from config-hid-type-fix, so there is no backlight device at all — brightness is stuck wherever iBoot left it. The driver exists in-tree (drivers/video/backlight/apple_dwi_bl.c appears in the MAINTAINERS Apple section). TASK: enable APPLE_DWI_BL in the kernel config, confirm the J614s DT actually describes the DWI backlight node (check t6040-j614s-dcuart.dts and the ADT for a dwi/backlight node — if absent, the DT work is the real task and the kernel symbol alone will do nothing), then verify /sys/class/backlight/*/brightness responds. Read/write of a backlight is not a PMU or charger write, so it is inside policy. Pair with 165 so dwm can bind brightness keys.
author: claude
